troubleshooters.name: Unlock APT & Fix Broken Package Database
troubleshooters.description: Terminates stuck apt/dpkg processes, removes stale lock files (/var/lib/dpkg/lock*), and runs dpkg --configure -a & apt --fix-broken install.
troubleshooters.fix_script:
killall -9 apt apt-get dpkg unattended-upgrade 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /var/lib/apt/lists/lock /var/cache/apt/archives/lock /var/lib/dpkg/lock* /var/lib/dpkg/updates/*
dpkg --configure -a
apt-get install -f -y
apt-get update --fix-missing

troubleshooters.name: Fix Random Wi-Fi Dropouts (Disable Power Saving)
troubleshooters.description: Disables aggressive 802.11 power saving in NetworkManager which causes Realtek and Intel Wi-Fi cards to drop connections randomly.
troubleshooters.fix_script:
mkdir -p /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d
cat << 'EOF' > /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/linforge-disable-wifi-powersave.conf
[connection]
wifi.powersave = 2
EOF
systemctl restart NetworkManager || true

troubleshooters.name: Restart & Reset PipeWire / WirePlumber Audio Stack
troubleshooters.description: Restarts user audio services, flushes ALSA state, un-mutes audio channels, and rebuilds WirePlumber endpoint configurations.
troubleshooters.fix_script:
alsactl init || true
amixer sset Master unmute 100% 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user restart pipewire wireplumber pipewire-pulse 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user daemon-reload

troubleshooters.name: Rebuild Broken DNS Resolver & Flush Caches
troubleshooters.description: Flushes systemd-resolved DNS cache and restores the proper /etc/resolv.conf symlink pointing to /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf.
troubleshooters.fix_script:
resolvectl flush-caches 2>/dev/null || systemd-resolve --flush-caches 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /etc/resolv.conf
ln -s /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf /etc/resolv.conf
systemctl restart systemd-resolved

troubleshooters.name: Repair Home Directory Ownership & Permissions
troubleshooters.description: Recursively restores your user ownership over ~/.config, ~/.cache, ~/.local, and ~/.local/share after accidentally running commands with sudo.
troubleshooters.fix_script:
REAL_USER="${SUDO_USER:-$USER}"
REAL_GROUP=$(id -gn "$REAL_USER")
REAL_HOME=$(eval echo "~$REAL_USER")
chown -R "${REAL_USER}:${REAL_GROUP}" "$REAL_HOME/.config" "$REAL_HOME/.cache" "$REAL_HOME/.local" "$REAL_HOME/.ssh" 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 700 "$REAL_HOME/.ssh" 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 600 "$REAL_HOME/.ssh/id_*" 2>/dev/null || true

troubleshooters.name: Fix NVIDIA Sleep / Resume Black Screen & Wayland Crash
troubleshooters.description: Enables NVIDIA systemd power management daemons (suspend/hibernate/resume) and sets modeset=1 fbdev=1 to prevent black screens upon wake.
troubleshooters.fix_script:
cat << 'EOF' > /etc/modprobe.d/nvidia-power-management.conf
options nvidia NVreg_PreserveVideoMemoryAllocations=1
options nvidia-drm modeset=1 fbdev=1
EOF
systemctl enable nvidia-suspend.service nvidia-hibernate.service nvidia-resume.service 2>/dev/null || true
update-initramfs -u || true

troubleshooters.name: Purge Broken & 404 Repository Sources
troubleshooters.description: Identifies invalid or obsolete third-party repository lists in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ that cause apt update to throw 404 or GPG signature errors.
troubleshooters.fix_script:
apt-get install -y ppa-purge 2>/dev/null || true
apt-get update 2>&1 | grep '404  Not Found' | awk '{print $NF}' | while read -r url; do
  domain=$(echo "$url" | awk -F/ '{print $3}')
  if [ -n "$domain" ]; then
    echo "Disabling broken repository with domain: $domain"
    grep -l "$domain" /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* 2>/dev/null | xargs -r -I {} mv {} {}.disabled
  fi
done || true
apt-get update -qq || true
